primary_source.title: LLM-Guided Strategy Synthesis for Scalable Equality Saturation

specified_surfaces: EqSatL grammar: named strategies, tagged rulesets, phase, sequence, repeat, and simplify nodes
best, promising, and pending strategy repository roles
Strategist, Generator, Evaluator, Partitioner, and Simplifier component roles
full, reduced, and minimal evaluator budget classes

hint-guided simplification score s(e)=c(e)+p_llm(e) with top-theta pruning
default base model and aggregate vectorization request/token counts
online timeout, memory limit, and extractor

exact Strategist prompt, context serialization, action schema, and action-selection policy
exact Generator prompt, decoding parameters, repair policy, and candidate schema
exact Partitioner and Simplifier prompts, decoding parameters, and retry policies
model service revision, inference parameters, random seeds, and nondeterminism policy
numerical full, reduced, and minimal evaluator budgets and promotion thresholds
best, promising, and pending repository admission, eviction, and tie-breaking rules
proof-tree local-region extraction algorithm and congruence-path traversal rules
stable concrete-rule-to-semantic-tag mapping and motif deduplication algorithm
motif utility combination formula, cache size, retention threshold, and tie-breaking
dependency-edge construction algorithm and direct, overlap, and subtree signal weights
domain coefficient grids and selected alpha, beta, gamma, and delta values
bounded p_llm construction and exact hint-to-penalty mapping
complete EqSatL-to-egglog lowering, execution, proof request, and error semantics
exact vectorization evolution/test case manifest, rewrites, costs, and expected outputs
exact synthesized strategy artifacts used for the reported held-out results

reproduction_rule.source_faithful_requires: an immutable executable upstream implementation or a complete defining algorithm plus exact fixtures
reproduction_rule.reason: The missing policy and execution choices are outcome-determining, not clerical build details.
